channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarcísio sobre ausência de Flávio e Lula em debate: 'Questão de estratégia'
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas described the absence of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula da Silva from the Band/Estadão presidential debate as an electoral strategy. The São Paulo governor and reelection candidate made the statement after the event was canceled for both candidates.

item.title: Candidato ao governo do Rio, Ruas diz que mulheres 'vão decidir futuro do Brasil'
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL) emphasized women's role in deciding Brazil's future and pledged to prioritize protection and autonomy for women in his administration.

item.title: Sebastião Coelho se diz "injustiçado" após atrito com Malafaia
item.description: Retired judge Sebastião Coelho (Novo), Senate candidate for the Federal District, says he feels wronged after Pastor Silas Malafaia warned that a divided right risks electing a left-wing senator and called him a "cretin." Coelho vows to continue his candidacy, registered July 21, and says he declined offers to be running mate for Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) and Bia Kicis (PL) due to his party commitment.

item.title: Douglas Ruas cita Madonna e diz que sua gestão terá "show da saúde"
item.description: Douglas Ruas criticized the Todo Mundo no Rio event and promised a 'show of health and security' in his government, contrasting it with celebrity shows like Madonna. He emphasized inclusive policies and attacked opponents, including Eduardo Paes.

item.title: Caso Lulinha: gabinete de Mendonça rebate suspeitas e defende investigação de vazamentos
item.description: The office of Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça rejected suspicions that the Lulinha case data leaks originated from the court itself. Lawyers for lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger requested the investigation be expanded to include agents with access to the case, such as two police delegates working in Mendonça's office, one of whom has tensions with the PF leadership. The office denied that the agents participated in anti-fascist dossiers or investigations, emphasizing Mendonça's support for probing the leaks.

item.title: O encontro de Messias e Alcolumbre na posse de Salomão no STJ
item.description: At the ceremony for Luís Felipe Salomão's swearing-in as STJ president, AGU minister Jorge Messias and Senate president Davi Alcolumbre met but did not speak. The tension stems from Messias's failed nomination to the STF, a defeat blamed on Alcolumbre, who briefly broke with Lula. Although Lula and Alcolumbre have resumed dialogue, Messias has not yet reconciled with the Senate president.

item.title: Haddad promete mudar uso de plataformas digitais nas escolas de SP: 'Esse terror vai acabar'
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) promised to change the use of digital platforms in São Paulo state schools on his first day in office, criticizing the policy of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. He also announced new public exams for teachers and advocated for greater pedagogical autonomy, supported by Marina Silva and Simone Tebet.

item.title: Careca do INSS sobre amiga de Lulinha: ‘Tá na folha? Tem que resolver’
item.description: The Federal Police investigate Careca do INSS for embezzling 6 billion reais and his influence on the government through Lulinha, President Lula's son. Messages reveal pressure to approve businesses involving cannabidiol-based medicines and payroll loan discounts, with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger acting as an intermediary.

item.title: Zema busca apoio de juristas evangélicos para tentar se aproximar do eleitorado religioso
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) has established a nucleus to engage the evangelical electorate, led by Uziel Santana, founder of Anajure. Santana views Zema as an alternative to Flávio Bolsonaro, though polls show the candidate has only 2% support among evangelicals.

item.title: Lula diz que sugeriu a Trump um “trago” com Xi e Putin depois da ONU
item.description: Lula suggested to Trump an informal meeting with Xi and Putin to seek peace in international conflicts, highlighting his concern about wars. During the call, Trump acknowledged that tariffs on Brazilian products were based on incorrect information, agreeing to advance trade negotiations. Lula also proposed cooperation between Brazil and the U.S. against organized crime, rejecting foreign interference.

item.title: Flávio dá nome de “Chiquinho” a cachorro que ganhou em ato no RJ
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) named 'Chiquinho' the dog rescued from animal abuse who was given to him during his campaign launch in Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro. The adoption was suggested by supporters and the name was chosen by his daughters. The event was used to associate the campaign with the law signed by Jair Bolsonaro that increased penalties for animal abuse.

item.title: PL tenta evitar voto casado em Flávio e Paes e aposta em ataques ao candidato do PSD
item.description: The PL party in Rio de Janeiro holds a campaign launch event for Douglas Ruas and uses the occasion to attack Eduardo Paes (PSD) to prevent the 'Flávio-Paes' split vote. The strategy involves linking Paes to Lula and Sérgio Cabral, as well as reviving the 'Nervosinho' nickname linked to Odebrecht. A Datafolha poll shows Paes leading with 41%, with Ruas in second place at 19%.

item.title: Tarcísio sobre ausência de Flávio e Lula em debate: ‘Gostaria de vê-los, mas é estratégia’
item.description: Tarcísio stated that Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula's absence from the debate is strategic, related to poll positioning. He criticized Brazil's economy and advocated for changes, highlighting alignment with city halls and benefits for São Paulo. He viewed polls as a "snapshot" of the moment.

item.title: Lula e Flávio realizam atos de campanha simultâneos no Rio de Janeiro neste sábado
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro hold simultaneous campaign rallies in Rio de Janeiro this Saturday, one day after the latest Datafolha poll. Lula leads the first round with 39% versus 33% for Flávio, while a runoff scenario shows a technical tie (47% to 43%). Rejection rates remain high and similar: 46% would not vote for Flávio, 45% would not vote for Lula.

item.title: Tarcísio fala em “capturar” votos de eleitores de Lula
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated he is aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential race but also aims to capture votes from Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) supporters, seeking to expand his electoral base beyond the conservative core.

item.title: Datafolha detalha a migração de votos de Zema, Caiado e Renan Santos no 2º turno; veja os números
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro would not inherit most 'third way' voters in a runoff against Lula. Romeu Zema would transfer 60% of his votes, Ronaldo Caiado 54%, and Renan Santos only 48%. In the first round, Lula leads with 39% vs 33% for Flávio; in a runoff, Lula would win 47% to 43%.

item.title: Veja imagens aéreas de mansão usada por Lulinha em Brasília
item.description: Poder360 released drone images of a 2,110 m² mansion in Brasília's Lago Sul frequented by Lulinha and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger. The property, rented in 2024 by dentist Rafael Nicolau Arbex, was allegedly used for meetings and hosting visitors. Both are under Federal Police investigation for suspected influence peddling and Social Security fraud.

item.title: A Faria Lima convida Flávio Bolsonaro para jantar
item.description: Faria Lima is already arranging dinners to hear Flávio Bolsonaro starting at the end of this month. The information is exclusive for subscribers, who must access the article's link to view the full content.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas de intenção de voto para presidente serão divulgadas nos próximos dias
item.description: At least three polling institutes will release new presidential voting intention polls in the coming days: Nexus (24th), Gerp (25th), and PoderData (27th). The latest Datafolha survey showed Lula leading both the first and second rounds, with Flávio Bolsonaro in second place.

item.title: Tarcísio afirma que ‘está com Flavio’, mas também ‘captura’ votos de eleitor de Lula
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for president but also signaled openness to Lula voters, emphasizing results and public policies over direct alliances. He maintains strategic distance from Flávio and avoids debates, focusing on his state administration.

item.title: Lula busca Trump como aliado improvável, diz Financial Times
item.description: President Lula reached out to Trump as an unlikely ally to ease tensions with Rubio and address U.S. tariffs. The call comes amid mutual criticism and trade measures, with Lula dismissing U.S. justifications as unfounded. Brazil is betting on direct leader-to-leader dialogue to create room for negotiations.

item.title: PL prega habilidade com STF para nacionalizar campanha de Michelle por Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Brazil's Liberal Party (PL) plans to nationalize Michelle Bolsonaro's Senate campaign in Brasília to boost Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid. The main hurdle is needing authorization from Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes for her to travel, since she oversees care for jailed ex-president Jair Bolsonaro. Party leadership urges allies to avoid attacking the STF to preserve the strategy, prioritizing campaign stops in the Northeast.

item.title: Há 4 anos, TSE barrou fala de Queiroga sobre vacinação
item.description: Four years ago, Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) blocked then-Health Minister Marcelo Queiroga's radio and TV broadcasts for mixing health information with electoral propaganda. In August 2026, current Health Minister Alexandre Padilha used the national broadcast to announce a multivaccination campaign without facing the same restriction. The article highlights the contrast between the electoral court's decisions across the two periods.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem vantagem entre mulheres, mais pobres e católicos
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula leading among women (51% to 38%), lower-income voters, and Catholics in a runoff simulation against Flávio Bolsonaro. The senator leads among men, higher-income voters, and evangelicals.

item.title: Datafolha reforça percepção de que a sucessão subiu no muro
item.description: Datafolha shows stability in the 2026 electoral scenario with no relevant changes. Lula's disapproval rises slightly and his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff is only four points. The only relevant shift occurs among undecided voters.

item.title: Lobista pagou viagem de Lulinha para África e Europa, diz revista
item.description: Federal Police wiretaps reveal that lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, planned a trip to Africa and Europe costing around $20,000 per person. The information is part of a Federal Police investigation and was reported by Veja magazine.

item.title: Quando é o dia das eleições presidenciais de 2026?
item.description: The 2026 presidential elections in Brazil will have the first round on October 4 and the second round on October 25. Voting will take place from 8 AM to 5 PM (Brasília time), with time zone adjustments in certain states. A valid photo ID is required to vote, with priority given to seniors, people with disabilities, and electoral authorities.

item.title: Romeu Zema ataca João Campos e o chama de ‘intocável das bets’
item.description: Romeu Zema publicly criticized João Campos in a social media video, labeling him the 'untouchable of betting companies' and condemning the use of public funds for campaigning and tax cuts for betting firms in Recife. He also referenced corruption allegations against Campos and pledged to ban betting companies if elected president.

item.title: Lula arrecada R$ 165.500 na 1ª semana da campanha nacional
item.description: Lula raised R$ 165,500 in the first week of his campaign, mostly from the PT party. Other candidates like Romeu Zema and Renan Santos reported much higher amounts. Several candidates have not yet registered any income in the official system.

item.title: Lula quer Trump como aliado improvável na briga com Rubio, diz jornal
item.description: President Lula is reaching out directly to Donald Trump to bypass pressure from the U.S. State Department, led by Marco Rubio, amid a worsening diplomatic crisis marked by 37.5% tariffs on Brazil. The strategy aims to leverage a more pragmatic relationship with Trump, as public spats between Lula and Rubio fuel the escalating dispute.

item.title: Datafolha: evitar vitória de um candidato é o que motiva escolha de 30% do eleitorado na disputa presidencial
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows that 30% of voters are motivated by preventing a specific candidate from winning, while 61% choose based on perceived competence. Among Lula's supporters, 23% vote to defeat an opponent, compared to 35% of Flávio Bolsonaro's base using the same negative motivation.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos à Presidência da República do Brasil nas eleições 2026
item.description: Thirteen candidates registered for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, including incumbent Lula (PT) seeking re-election and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) representing the Bolsonaro legacy, as Jair Bolsonaro is ineligible and imprisoned. The first round takes place on October 4.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que estará com Flávio Bolsonaro e lamenta possíveis ausências em debates presidenciais: 'Gostaria de vê-los'
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas confirmed his support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, emphasizing that his administration operates with pragmatism regardless of party affiliation. He expressed a desire to see both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro participate in presidential debates, stating that it helps voters engage with the candidates. The governor advocates for a distinct political alternative and seeks alliances with municipalities across various parties.

item.title: Lula vê Trump como 'aliado improvável' em embate do Brasil contra Marco Rubio, diz Financial Times
item.description: Lula seeks alliance with Trump to counter Marco Rubio in struggle for influence over Brazil, according to Financial Times. Bilateral ties sour amid mutual accusations, as Lula navigates foreign policy amid domestic elections. The strategy aims to counter Rubio's support for conservative candidate Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Centrão evita Flávio para recuperar espaço, diz especialista
item.description: The Centrão avoids supporting Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round to recover space lost to Bolsonaro-aligned candidates in recent elections. Center parties view the 2026 election as an opportunity to counter the advance of Bolsonarismo-linked figures, especially in the Chamber of Deputies, where high parliamentary turnover favored these candidates.

item.title: Uma lição de Mendonça a Moraes e Dino
item.description: André Mendonça gave his first long exclusive interview as a Supreme Federal Court minister to a podcast from his own institute, nearly five years after taking office. The minister, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro, shared his views on judicial and political issues, offering a lesson to other ministers like Moraes and Dino.

item.title: Lula ampliou espaço do Centrão para isolar Flávio em 2026
item.description: Lula expanded ministerial positions to include Centrão parties, trading cargos and emendas to keep them neutral toward Flávio in 2026. This strategy weakened Flávio's access to state media and campaign resources. The move focused on securing congressional majority while preventing a unified opposition bloc.

item.title: Mensagem de lobista liga Lulinha a reunião de governador no Planalto
item.description: The Federal Police found messages on lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger's phone linking Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, to a meeting with the governor of Maranhão, Carlos Brandão, held at the Planalto Palace. According to the lobbyist, Lulinha allegedly promised to approve a construction project in the state during the meeting. The findings were reported by Estadão and O Antagonista.

item.title: Com maior fatia do fundo, PL tem rombo de R$ 80 milhões em verba para campanhas
item.description: The PL faces an R$80 million deficit in campaign funding distribution for 2026, despite being the largest recipient of the electoral fund. Money management is led by Valdemar Costa Neto, who already spent R$120 million in pre-campaign activities. The party's presidential ticket is headed by Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Durigan usa imprecisões ao defender política fiscal de Lula
item.description: Finance Minister Dário Durigan defends Lula's fiscal policy using imprecise claims, omitting Central Bank criticism and failing to compare public debt with the previous administration. He blames inflation on the Middle East war and interest rates, ignoring the impact of excessive spending.

item.title: Justiça da Bolívia decreta a prisão preventiva de Fernando Cerimedo, aliado do clã Bolsonaro
item.description: Bolivian justice has ordered the preventive arrest of Fernando Cerimedo, an advisor to Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz, on suspicion of being the mastermind behind a shooting attack against his former partner, lawyer Nadia Beller. Cerimedo, a 45-year-old Argentine, is known for spreading disinformation about Brazilian elections and for having coordinated Javier Milei's digital campaign strategy in Argentina.

item.title: Lulinha 'conseguiu agenda' para governador do MA no Planalto, diz jornal
item.description: Messages found by the Federal Police on lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger's phone suggest Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, mediated a meeting between Maranhão Governor Carlos Brandão and the Planalto Palace. The information was released by Estadão, raising concerns about political influence in federal government agendas.

item.title: EUA procuram governo Lula para retomar negociação sobre tarifaço
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump indicated to Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva the resumption of talks regarding tariffs imposed on Brazilian products, following a phone call between the two leaders last Friday (August 21, 2026). The Ministry of Development, Industry, Trade and Services received contact from Jamieson Greer, the U.S. Trade Representative representative, and a technical meeting is scheduled for next week. The negotiations had been stalled since July, after the U.S. officially introduced new tariffs on Brazilian goods, and Lula emphasized that the justifications for the surcharges are unfounded and harmful to both countries.

item.title: Fluminense x Remo no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Fluminense and Remo face off on Saturday at 4 PM at Maracanã in the 24th round of the Brazilian Championship. Fluminense, fourth with 38 points, aims to build on their recent form under interim coach Marcão, while Remo fights against relegation. The match will be broadcast exclusively on Premiere.

item.title: PT publica foto de ato em BH e provoca Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT posted a photo from the Belo Horizonte rally and taunted Flávio Bolsonaro, while Lula urged votes for the allied ticket and criticized US tariffs. Flávio was also in Minas with government proposals and attacks on the PT.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos à Presidência neste fim de semana
item.description: Presidential candidates hold campaign activities over the weekend, including debates, events, and launches. The first 2026 presidential debate will take place on Sunday broadcast by Grupo Bandeirantes.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio lidera entre eleitores do Sul e evangélicos, enquanto Lula tem vantagem entre mulheres, pobres e pretos
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula at 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43% for a potential runoff, within margin of error. Lula leads among women, blacks, Catholics and low-income voters, while Flávio leads among evangelicals, Southerners and middle-class voters.

item.title: Datafolha confirma tracking e derruba tese de Flávio, dizem petistas
item.description: The Datafolha poll confirmed Lula's internal tracking numbers, keeping the PT ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro by 4 points in a hypothetical runoff. The campaign interpreted the result as a refutation of claims that the race was tied. Crises involving Lula's relatives and former aides have not impacted voting intentions so far.

item.title: Letícia Barros na Crusoé: O Leviatã eleitoral
item.description: The 2026 electoral campaign will feature a stricter TSE, empowered to suspend content deemed AI-manipulated, with immediate removal and burden of proof on the sender. Letícia Barros is highlighted as a key figure in the discussion on electoral control versus freedom of expression. The article raises concerns about the tribunal’s discretionary power over political information.

item.title: Datafolha expõe a fraqueza da ‘3ª via’ antes de debate esvaziado na ‘Band’
item.description: Datafolha polling confirms Lula's lead (39%) over Flávio Bolsonaro (33%), while third-way candidates show low support. Without the two leading figures, the Band TV debate will feature only four pre-candidates. The weakness of the third way is highlighted by the low voting intentions among other contenders.
